verdict.rationale: The pack documents split-payment instructions for marketplace transactions. It also documents an MCP server, but that server helps developers build integrations using natural language. Nothing in the pack shows agent-initiated checkout, support for agentic-commerce protocols, or delegated payment credentials for agent buyers, so the story's core capability is unevidenced. Split funds and the developer MCP server are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform is ready for agent buyers — documented support for agent-initiated checkout on marketplace transactions (agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials) that works with split funds flows
